title: Ask for the actual local repository path before issuing YAML execution jobs
abstract: Before preparing or executing a YAML-specified job that operates on an existing local Git repository, request and use the user's actual local repository filesystem path instead of assuming its location.

source.reference: Generalized local repository YAML execution practice; original private conversation and language not reproduced

scope_hints.scope_boundary: YAML execution jobs for the user's existing local repository; not blanket authorization to touch other repositories

unresolved: Review the applicable job specification and trigger before normalization.
Distinguish mandatory git pull from the separate need to handle pull failures or non-fast-forward updates safely.
Confirm there is no implicit authorization to fabricate, create, clone, or modify an unrelated repository.
remarks: Queued atomic proposal only. No specimen processing, catalog publication, local job execution, repository creation, or downstream task authorization is implied.
